title: A note beside the shared pear tree
titleZh: 共用梨樹旁的採果告示
passage:
PEAR TREE | Message from the courtyard gardeners

Pears on the low branches are for residents to pick. Take no more than two attached pears per household until Saturday’s count is finished. Please leave the high branches alone; the gardeners will deal with them separately. On the low branches, a green tie at the base of a branch means that branch has been counted for our records. You may pick only from low branches with a green tie.

Pears that have already fallen onto the grass are handled differently. If they still look sound, put them in the shallow tray by the door. They do not count toward your household’s two-pear limit if you take them from the tray. Leave fruit on the path where it is; a gardener is keeping those pieces there temporarily so the maintenance crew can see where fruit is landing.

On Saturday morning the gardeners will add green ties as they count more branches. The ties show only which branches were counted; they say nothing about whether individual pears are ripe. We’ll post a new notice when the count is done.
passageZh:
梨樹｜中庭園藝志工留言

低枝上的梨可由住戶採摘。星期六的盤點完成前，每戶最多可摘兩顆還長在樹上的梨。請勿動高枝，園藝志工會另行處理。低枝靠近樹幹處綁有綠色帶子的，表示該枝已完成盤點並留有紀錄。只能在綁綠帶的低枝採摘。

已掉到草地上的梨要另外處理。外觀看起來完好的，請放進門旁的淺盤。若從盤裡拿梨，不計入每戶兩顆的上限。掉在步道上的水果請留在原處；一位園藝志工暫時讓那些水果留在那裡，好讓維護人員看見水果掉落的位置。

星期六上午，園藝志工會盤點更多枝條，並在盤點後加上綠帶。綠帶只顯示哪些枝條已盤點，並不表示個別梨子是否成熟。盤點完成後，我們會張貼新的告示。
